key_insight: Policy optimization can suppress optimal responses even while reward improves, but KL regularization with repeated reference resets can preserve access to the base model’s capabilities.
engineering_relevance: The results provide theoretical guidance for designing post-training objectives and reference-update schedules that avoid stalled optimization.
method: Analyze coverage collapse under REINFORCE, including with exact gradients and fixed-reference KL regularization.
Introduce Approximate Policy Mirror Descent to solve successive KL-regularized subproblems with reference resets.
Prove coverage-preserving convergence for stylized PPO, GRPO, and squared-loss variants with softmax linear policies.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical failure examples and global convergence guarantees tied to base-model response coverage, rather than empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Guarantees rely on softmax linear policies over pretrained features and stylized algorithms; applicability to full neural-network post-training remains unestablished here.
paper_title: A Theory of Policy Optimization in Post-Training: Coverage Collapse and Reference Resets
